strategy: Domain-driven decomposition by HR subdomain; module boundaries drawn at PL/SQL package + Oracle Forms form pairs. Coupling scored 0-10 (10 = tightest).

modules.name: Employee
modules.description: Employee lifecycle management: create, update, terminate, rehire, search, org-chart, history.
modules.coupling_notes: Circular dependency with MOD-02 (Payroll). PKG_EMPLOYEE.create_employee calls PKG_PAYROLL.create_salary_record; PKG_PAYROLL validates employee active status via PKG_EMPLOYEE.is_active. Evidence: PKG_EMPLOYEE.pkb, PKG_PAYROLL.pkb, PKG_EMPLOYEE.pks comment.

modules.name: Payroll
modules.description: Payroll processing: salary records, pay elements, payroll run calculation, tax calculation, pay register report generation, GL journal export.
modules.coupling_notes: Circular dependency with MOD-01. PKG_PAYROLL.calculate_payroll triggers PKG_INTEGRATION.generate_gl_journal for approved runs.

modules.name: Leave
modules.description: Leave management: request submission/approval/rejection/cancellation, leave type management, monthly accruals, year-end carryover, holiday calendar.
modules.coupling_notes: PKG_EMPLOYEE.terminate_employee cancels pending leave requests directly — tight but unidirectional. PKG_LEAVE is otherwise a well-isolated module.

modules.name: Performance
modules.description: Annual performance review cycles: review creation, self-assessment, manager review, goal tracking, acknowledgement, rating distribution.
modules.coupling_notes: Least coupled domain module. Only reads EMPLOYEES (JOIN) and uses shared infrastructure packages.

modules.name: Security / Auth
modules.description: Authentication (login/logout/session management), authorisation (grade-based RBAC), SSN encryption/decryption, password management.
modules.coupling_notes: All 6 forms attach HRMS_COMMON_LIB which calls PKG_SECURITY.is_session_valid on every form navigation. HRMS_MENU enforces PKG_SECURITY.has_permission for PAYROLL, ADMIN, REPORTS. This package is a cross-cutting concern. Hard-coded encryption key in source is critical finding.

modules.name: Integration / Cross-Cutting
modules.description: External system integrations (GL journal, ADP benefits feed, time-attendance import), async notification queue, shared utilities, validation, reporting, audit trail.
shared_tables: ALL domain tables (via reporting and audit)
modules.coupling_notes: PKG_COMMON and PKG_AUDIT are called by every other package. PKG_NOTIFICATION is called by every domain module. This module is a true shared kernel — not independently deployable.

inter_module_dependencies.reason: PKG_LEAVE reads EMPLOYEES table for active status and manager lookup
PKG_PERFORMANCE reads EMPLOYEES for review generation and manager assignment
PKG_SECURITY reads EMPLOYEES for authentication and JOB_GRADES for permission check

cycles.description: PKG_EMPLOYEE.create_employee calls PKG_PAYROLL.create_salary_record; PKG_PAYROLL calls PKG_EMPLOYEE.is_active for validation
